title: Tokens can follow players between maps
summary: DMs can let players' character tokens follow them when they open another map in the same place.
items: A new setting, off by default: Character tokens follow players' map view.
When it's on, opening another map in the same place moves your character's token there, with Undo.
Maps in other places are just for looking, and tokens stay put during combat.
Players can turn off Follow me to browse without moving their token.
